description: Main source file for an automation utility program, implementing command-line interface and core functions for importing, assembling, disassembling, removing, and clearing automations.

methods.name: printUsage
methods.description: Prints usage instructions for the command-line utility.

methods.name: importAutomation
methods.description: Imports an automation file from a specified path into the project directory.

methods.name: assembleAutomation
methods.description: Assembles an imported automation into a deployable form.

methods.name: disassembleAutomation
methods.description: Disassembles an imported automation into editable files.

methods.name: disassembleImportedAutomation
methods.description: Disassembles automation contents into a directory structure.

methods.name: removeAutomation
methods.description: Removes an imported automation by name.

methods.name: clearAllAutomations
methods.description: Clears all imported automations from the output directory.
